title: KHR_texture_procedural_rendering glTF Texture Extension
description: The procedure a texture is drawn from until its picture (the texture's own `source`) has arrived.

procedure.description: The index of the procedure in the root extension object's `procedures` array.

views.description: One procedure and one picture for each eye: exactly two entries, `left` and `right`. The left eye's pair MUST be the texture's own.
